judged_text: BaseCalendarService.createEvent filters the credential's calendars against only the first destinationCalendar entry's externalId, ignoring which host's credential is in play. For collective multi-host bookings on caldav/other_calendar integrations, every host's credential filters against the first host's externalId, so hosts whose calendars don't include it create no event at all (Promise.all over an empty list) and their calendars silently miss the booking.

For collective multi-host bookings on caldav/other_calendar integrations, every host's credential filters against the first host's externalId, so hosts whose calendars don't include it create no event at all (Promise.all over an empty list) and their calendars silently miss the booking.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `destinationCalendar` to an array and updates `BaseCalendarService.createEvent` to derive `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []` and then filter calendars by only `mainHostDestinationCalendar.externalId` (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts). In `handleNewBooking`, for COLLECTIVE team events it appends other hosts’ `destinationCalendar`s into `evt.destinationCalendar` (so multiple entries exist), but `BaseCalendarService` still filters against only the first entry. Since `CalendarManager.createEvent` now passes only `credentialId` into `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (no per-host externalId selection), a non-first host’s CalDAV/other_calendar credential may have no calendar matching the first host’s externalId, yielding an empty `.map(...)` and thus no event created for that host.
